scope: Read-only static audit plus isolated fixture probes; no user media, installs, repo edits, or suite runs

probes.name: COPY_RACE
probes.setup: During append_only_copy progress callback create destination containing ARCHIVE ORIGINAL
probes.result: returned copied; destination became NEW, overwriting concurrent archive original

probes.name: RUNLOCK_RACE
probes.setup: Two begin_active_run calls read None before synchronization barrier; resume second after first finishes begin
probes.result: both returned success; final marker plan 2

probes.name: STALE_SKIP
probes.setup: Persist skip_existing_same_name_size row, remove fixture destination, execute persisted plan
probes.result: plan done; review items 0; audit not_applicable; source present; destination absent

probes.name: CHANGED_MOVE
probes.setup: Persist MOVE row size 3, change fixture source from old to changed source, execute plan
probes.result: source moved; destination changed source; audit size_mismatch; plan done; review items 0

probes.name: CHANGED_DUPLICATE
probes.setup: Hash-review matching old pair; replace source with same-size new before duplicate removal
probes.result: unique source deleted; destination still old; audit source_removed_after_sha256_match

probes.name: SYMLINK_FORCE_DELETE
probes.setup: Yard source is symlink to outside/IMG_0001.CR3; destination den/IMG_0001.CR3 has equal bytes; hash-review and remove
probes.result: verified 1, rejected 0; outside target deleted; yard symlink remains; den exists
